proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Reduce to a generator [Z_K] with Z integral closed dominating R, where the specialization map is determined by sp([Z_K]) = [Z_kappa]_r by construction; the inverse image Z' of Z is flat over the DVR by integrality and domination, so its specialization is computed by the specialization-closed lemma; the two flat pullbacks of the generic and closed fibres of Z are computed by the cited Chow Homology lemma and agree with the corresponding fibres of Z', so the square commutes (source lines 527-539)

core_obligations: Show that the specialization diagram with flat pullback vertical arrows commutes (proof lines 527-539). By linearity reduce to a generator: let Z be an integral closed subscheme of X dominating R; by the construction of sp_{X/R} we have sp_{X/R}([Z_K]) = [Z_kappa]_r, and this characterizes the specialization map (proof lines 528-530). Set Z' = f^{-1}(Z) = X' x_X Z; since R is a valuation ring the integral Z dominating R is flat over R, hence Z' is flat over R, and sp_{X'/R}([Z'_K]_{r+e}) = [Z'_kappa]_{r+e} by lemma-specialization-closed (tag 0H4J) (proof lines 531-535); by chow-lemma-pullback-coherent (tag 02RE) f_K^*[Z_K] = [Z'_K]_{r+e} and f_kappa^*[Z_kappa]_r = [Z'_kappa]_{r+e}, so both compositions send [Z_K] to [Z'_kappa]_{r+e} and the diagram commutes (proof lines 536-538).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to generators [Z_K] with Z integral closed dominating R, where the specialization value is fixed by construction (proof lines 528-530).
Flatness of Z' over R via integrality and domination, and its specialization computed by the specialization-closed lemma (proof lines 531-535).
Both flat pullbacks computed by the Chow Homology lemma agree with the fibres of Z', closing the square (proof lines 536-538).
